categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches fuzz tests and benchmarks, but only to verify and measure the specific block index comparator changes rather than modifying test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: The category covers general test infrastructure and framework machinery, whereas these unit tests, benchmarks, and differential fuzz harnesses specifically accompany the block index comparison optimization.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Modifies `CBlockIndexWorkComparator` in `src/node/blockstorage.h` and arithmetic comparisons used for chainstate block index management.
categories.rationale: Optimizes hot-path block index work comparison logic used during chainstate evaluation and candidates sorting. Benchmarks show `CBlockIndexWorkComparator` throughput increases 6.5x–6.8x and `CheckBlockIndex` ops/s improve 1.4x–1.6x, providing a worthwhile micro-optimization to block index operations.
